newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia closes Indonesia border posts after riots.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia closes Indonesia border posts after riots.

text.p: Malaysia closed part of its border with Indonesia on Borneo island on Monday in the wake of recent racial riots on the Indonesian side, the national news agency Bernama said.
All border posts between Malaysia's Borneo state of Sarawak and Indonesia's West Kalimantan province would be closed indefinitely, Bernama quoted a State Security Council order as saying.

The order follows news reports that some 5,000 indigenous Dayak tribesmen burned and looted scores of homes and businesses belonging to settlers from the Indonesian island of Madura in rioting last month, Bernama said.
The border closure has stranded hundreds of Indonesians working in Sarawak, preventing them from returning home for the Moslem holiday of Eid al-Fitr this weekend.
Bernama said extra policemen had been deployed at the border.
Malaysia occupies the northern third of Borneo and Indonesia has the southern two-thirds.

Under Indonesia's controversial transmigration programme, tens of thousands of settlers from the overcrowded islands of Java and Madura have been shifted to less-populated areas such as Kalimantan (Indonesian Borneo) and Sumatra island.
